$comment: Generated by scripts/build-tools.mjs from each Actor's public Apify input schema. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run build:tools`.

tools.name: publicrecords--spotify-play-count-scraper
tools.title: Spotify Play Count & Monthly Listeners Scraper
tools.description:
Spotify Play Count & Monthly Listeners Scraper. Play counts for every track of any Spotify album, playlist or artist, plus monthly listeners and followers for artists. Optional streams per day for tracked tracks. No login.

When to use: Use when you need Spotify play counts: the total plays of every track behind a track, album, artist or playlist link, plus an artist's monthly listeners, followers, world rank and top cities. Optional streams over the last 1, 7 and 30 days for tracks already in daily tracking; those fields stay empty for a track's first day and fill in once it has history. Good for release tracking, playlist checks and artist comparisons; not for private Spotify for Artists data or royalties.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper

urls.title: Spotify links
urls.description: One per line: track, album, artist or playlist links (open.spotify.com/…) or URIs (spotify:album:…). Example: ["https://open.spotify.com/album/4aawyAB9vmqN3uQ7FjRGTy"]

addDailyStreams.title: Add daily streams (last 1, 7 and 30 days)
addDailyStreams.description: Adds streams per day for tracks we have been tracking. Tracks seen for the first time get empty values today and history from tomorrow.

includeArtistAlbums.title: For artist links, also scrape their albums and singles
includeArtistAlbums.description: Off: an artist link returns the artist row plus its top tracks. On: also every track of the albums and singles shown on the artist page (slower).

maxTracksPerTarget.title: Max tracks per link
maxTracksPerTarget.description: 0 means no limit. Large playlists and full catalogs can run to thousands of tracks.
